test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: The average of four numbers was 44. With the inclusion of a fifth number, y, the new average dropped to 42. What is the value of y?
solution:
Given: 

The average of the four numbers was 44.

If the age of the fifth number is also included, the average dropped to 42

Concept Used:

Average Value = (Sum of all the values)/(Total values)

Calculations:

According to the question,

Let the fifth number be y, then

y =(5 × 42) - (4 × 44)

⇒ y = 210 - 176

⇒ y = 34 

∴ The age of the fifth member is 34 years.
